summary: Standing Marion County, Texas, tower; sources disagree on whether it is the 2003 downtown move or a separate Loc 2 site.

facts.design: Aermotor MC-39 tower with 7 ft by 7 ft cab
facts.status_note: The register says it stands in downtown Jefferson as a cell tower; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks the Loc 1 point gone and Loc 2 standing.

access.note: Owned by Etex Wireless and used as a cell tower; no public access is described.

events.note: Texas Forest Service crew leader posted at the Jefferson lookout tower
Coast and Geodetic Survey station description: glass-enclosed cab on a four-legged steel structure about 100 feet tall, about 1.5 miles west-northwest of Jefferson
Moved by the Jeffersonian Institute to a present location in downtown Jefferson, according to the register; the register's coordinates match the Loc 1 point

evidence.supports: Texas Forest Service crew leader posted at the Jefferson lookout tower, September 30, 1957 (Marshall News Messenger item)
evidence.quote: Henry Lee Price has joined the Texas Forest Service at Jefferson lookout tower as crewleader for the Jefferson Crew Area.

evidence.supports: glass-enclosed cab on a four-legged steel structure

STEEL STRUCTURE AND HAS AN OVER-ALL HEIGHT OF ABOUT 100 FEET.

evidence.supports: moved in 2003 by the Jeffersonian Institute to downtown Jefferson
evidence.quote: In 2003 the tower was moved by the Jeffersonian Institute to its present location in downtown Jefferson, Texas.

evidence.supports: owned by Etex Wireless and used as a cell tower
evidence.quote: It is currently owned by Etex Wireless and used as a cell tower.

evidence.supports: tourism office and chamber offered to help restore the steps and open the tower
evidence.quote: The Jefferson Office of Tourism Development and Marion County Chamber of Commerce are offering to work with Etex Wireless to restore the steps of the tower and open it as an educational, historical resource.

evidence.supports: Loc 2 listed as standing and relocated from Loc 1

evidence.quote: Jefferson (Loc 1) Marion 32.76609 -94.37769 Tower Gone FFLOS US 1168, TX 1

corrections.current: Moved a short way, to a new spot on the same site.
corrections.proposed: Relocated from Jefferson (Loc 1). The register says it was moved in 2003 to a present location in downtown Jefferson. No source gives the distance or says it stayed on the same site.
corrections.why: No fetched source says the move was short or on the same site. The register's coordinates and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list place the tower at different points, about 3.4 km apart.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the standing tower at Loc 2, about 3.4 km east of the Loc 1 point it marks gone. The register gives Loc 1 coordinates for a tower it says stands in downtown Jefferson. The distance is computed from the listed coordinates. Not resolved by sources read.

The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists Loc 1 as gone and Loc 2 as standing. The register says the tower is standing and in use as a cell tower. Current condition and date of the register text are unknown.

notes_for_editor: Register (firetower.org) and FFLA list disagree on the location and status of the standing tower; no build date found. Distance of about 3.4 km is computed from the listed coordinates. The 1957 quote is from a Marshall News Messenger item reproduced on the centraluslookouts page; the newspaper itself was not read. Searches for a Jimplecute article on a tower move found nothing. Related record us-tx-jefferson (Loc 1) says relocated while FFLA says gone and the register says standing downtown; that record needs a separate pass.
